[[File:Judicials-raid.jpg|thumb|250px|Judicials raid an illegal [[Pit racing|pit race]].]]
'''Judicials''', or the '''Judicial Forces'''<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> were members of the [[Judicial Department/Legends|Judicial Department]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They were often tasked with working alongside the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in policing the Republic, arresting [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and other law-breakers.

The Judicials were formed from the [[Republic Army]] after the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]]. Those serving in the [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] served as a paramilitary force for the Republic until the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], when they were incorporated into the restored [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].

The official police force on [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] were also called Judicials.
